newsitem.title: POLAND: KOMPAP SEES 1997 NET AT PLN 4.8 MLN.
newsitem.headline: KOMPAP SEES 1997 NET AT PLN 4.8 MLN.

text.p: Polish paper maker Kompap SA forecasts that its 1997 net profit will increase to at least 4.8 million zlotys in 1997 from last year's 2.8 million zlotys, the company's president said on Tuesday.
"This result may prove to be even better, as signalled by good results in the last two months," Jerzy Grzanka told Reuters in an interview.
Grzanka said his company planned to invest seven million zlotys this year mainly to modernise its equipment.
It also wanted to buy shares in printing companies in the next several months, he added without elaborating.
Grzanka said Kompap had no plan to issue new shares in 1997 or to raise capital through other instruments. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
